scope: ESRB original MuJoCo scenes inspired by open source task designs; no ManiSkill runtime, assets or code copied

robot.reuse: existing shared Panda binding and vendored Apache-2.0 model

constrained_push.borrowed_concept: contact-only object pushing to a target; ESR adds machined pallet, guide rails, tapered docking section and stable withdrawal verification

force_alignment.borrowed_concept: matching workpiece pose to a fixture; ESR uses a lead-in guide, contact-triggered lateral correction, datum alignment and release verification

compliant_assembly.borrowed_concept: horizontal insertion and mating-frame position/rotation checks; ESR adds keyed shaft, grasp hub, support cradle and contact admittance
